record.summary: The render matches the reference; the only differences are the accepted Text size line, the new Chat width row and the new Rich text section, which push Navigation down so its rows and the sections below it are past the bottom edge.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Text size: the control is enabled, with Default selected as in the reference, and the line under it says "Scales the text of the whole app. Small is the size of the designs." in place of "Scales the whole app: Small 87.5 %, Default 100 %, Large 112.5 %." (d-122 and d-131). The line has a different length, so on a narrow screen it can take one more or one less text line than the reference, and every section below it then sits that much lower or higher.
accepted_deviations.note: Default is selected and the control is enabled. The new line fits on one line, as the reference line does.

accepted_deviations.as_given: A new "NOTIFICATIONS" section with one "Notifications" switch (off) sits between the Navigation section and the New chat defaults section. So New chat defaults sits lower, or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: Navigation starts at about y=1010 and runs past the bottom edge, so the Notifications section and New chat defaults are not in the frame. This is what the description says will happen.

accepted_deviations.as_given: The Notifications switch moved to that section: the desktop rail no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" switch at its bottom, and the More drawer no longer has the "Notifications / Blocked in Settings" row at its end. So the drawer is shorter and its top edge sits lower.
accepted_deviations.note: This frame has no desktop rail and the More drawer is closed.

accepted_deviations.as_given: The Navigation list has a new last row, "Settings", with the line "Always shown: in the bar or under More." under it and up and down buttons but no switch (the owner's decision: Settings is an entry of the bar order that cannot be hidden). So Toolkit's down button is now enabled, the Navigation card is taller, and every section below it sits lower or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: Only the Home row of Navigation is in the frame. The Toolkit and Settings rows are below the bottom edge.

accepted_deviations.as_given: On the phone and the tablet only: a thin rule line with the text "Under More on this device" under it sits after the last page that the tab bar shows (Projects on the phone, Artifacts on the tablet), so the rows after it sit lower by about 40 px.
accepted_deviations.note: The Artifacts row of Navigation is below the bottom edge, so the rule line under it is not in the frame.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Appearance has a new last row, "Chat width", under Text size: a three-way control "Full", "Wide", "Narrow" with Full selected, and a line under it. On the desktop and the tablet the control is enabled and the line says "The messages and the message box of a Workspaces chat, centred."; on the phone the control is disabled (muted labels) and the line says "Phone: always full". So the Appearance card is taller, and every section below it sits lower (about one row) or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: Full is selected, the control is enabled, and the line says "The messages and the message box of a Workspaces chat, centred." The Appearance card ends at about y=535, where it ends at about y=435 in the reference.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Rich text: a new "RICH TEXT" section sits between Appearance and Navigation, with the line "Off shows the plain Markdown. No text is hidden." and six switches, all on: Callouts, Code highlighting, Chat links (with the line "Chat bubbles in messages" under it), Mermaid diagrams, Math and Images (bridge-coord, 2026-11-25, the owner's request). So Navigation and every section below it sit lower, or below the bottom edge.
accepted_deviations.note: The section has the line, the six switches (all on) and the "Chat bubbles in messages" line under Chat links. Navigation starts below it, at about y=1010.

limits: The Navigation rows after Home, the Notifications section and New chat defaults are below the bottom edge of the render, so I could not compare them.
